categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen DOBOT Corp Ltd primarily engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of collaborative robots (cobots). Their product portfolio includes 27 cobot models across four series, serving diverse applications in manufacturing, retail, healthcare, STEAM education, scientific research, and commercial sectors such as autonomous coffee stations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on full-stack in-house R&D covering cobot design, key component development, controller systems, algorithms, and AI integration. Key technological breakthroughs include safety systems, operational stability, autonomous mobility, AI-empowered cobots, and embodied intelligence robotics such as humanoid robots with dexterous manipulation and bipedal locomotion. Manufacturing emphasizes high-quality control systems and domestic substitution of core components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DOBOT serves over 80 Fortune Global 500 companies and targets industries including automotive, 3C electronics, new energy, metal processing, food and beverage, healthcare, scientific research, education, retail, and agriculture. Their cobots support digital and intelligent upgrading in global manufacturing, commercial retail, medical surgeries, physiotherapy, and education sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with sales in over 80 countries and regions. It has subsidiaries and localized teams in the United States, Germany, Japan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Most non-current assets are located in Mainland China, while revenue is generated from both domestic and overseas customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: DOBOT operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a technology-driven product company that designs, develops, and manufactures collaborative robots. They have strong upstream capabilities with over 90% self-developed core components and focus on downstream commercialization and after-sales services globally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on embodied AI robotics, emphasizing safety, user-friendliness, adaptability, and ecosystem compatibility. R&D priorities include advancing vision sensor technology, force feedback control, AI integration for autonomous learning, and developing robots with higher payloads and faster task cycles. They also focus on expanding global market presence and building strategic alliances and sales channels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of various cobot models and integrated robotic solutions. The company also derives income from after-sales services and capital market activities such as initial public offerings. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DOBOT is positioned as a leading player in the global collaborative robotics industry, ranking first in China and second globally by shipment volume. It competes with other industrial and collaborative robot manufacturers, leveraging its full-stack technology, AI integration, and broad application scenarios to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, DOBOT reported revenue of RMB 373.7 million, a 30.3% increase from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 46.6%. Despite a net loss of RMB 95.4 million, the loss decreased compared to prior years, reflecting improved operational efficiency. The company has total assets of RMB 1.5 billion and equity of RMB 967 million, supported by a successful IPO raising significant capital for growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DOBOT emphasizes high-quality, reliable, durable, and safe collaborative robots with advanced AI and embodied intelligence capabilities. Their products offer superior precision, operational stability, and adaptability across diverse industries. The company’s unique value lies in its full-stack self-developed technology, innovative AI-empowered cobots, and comprehensive ecosystem enabling seamless human-robot collaboration.
